name: daily-pipeline

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 17 * * *'          # 00:30 WIB
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full_refresh:
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: daily-pipeline
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}

jobs:
  generate:                         # hanya untuk simulasi; hapus bila OLTP diisi aplikasi nyata
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r oltp/generator/requirements.txt
      - run: python oltp/generator/generate.py daily --date "$(TZ=Asia/Jakarta date -d yesterday +%F)"
        env:
          SOURCE_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}

  ingest:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r ingestion/requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_INGEST }}
      - run: python ingestion/pipeline.py
        env:
          SOURCE_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}
          DESTINATION__BIGQUERY__LOCATION: asia-southeast2
          DESTINATION__BIGQUERY__CREDENTIALS__PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}

  transform:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: ingest
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: dbt
    env:
      DBT_PROFILES_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/dbt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_DBT }}
      - run: dbt deps
      - run: dbt source freshness --target prod
      - name: dbt build (full refresh mingguan tiap Senin dini hari, atau manual)
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.full_refresh }}" = "true" ] || [ "$(TZ=Asia/Jakarta date +%u)" = "1" ]; then
            dbt build --target prod --full-refresh
          else
            dbt build --target prod
          fi
      - run: dbt docs generate --target prod
        if: always()
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: prod-manifest
          path: |
            dbt/target/manifest.json
            dbt/target/run_results.json
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Siapkan artefak dokumentasi bersih
        id: prep_docs
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f target/index.html ]; then
            mkdir -p docs_site
            cp target/index.html target/manifest.json target/catalog.json docs_site/ 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "has_docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_docs=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        if: steps.prep_docs.outputs.has_docs == 'true'
        with:
          path: dbt/docs_site

  deploy-docs:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.transform.result == 'success'
    needs: transform
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
    steps:
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

  export-dashboard:                 # JSON mart -> dashboard Vercel
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: transform
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r dashboard/requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_EXPORT }}
      - run: python dashboard/export_marts.py
        env:
          GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}
      - name: Commit data bila berubah (memicu deploy Vercel)
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add dashboard/public/data
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(dashboard): refresh data $(date -u +%F)"
            git pull --rebase origin main || { git rebase --abort; exit 1; }
            git push origin main || (sleep 3 && git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main)
          fi

name: pr-ci

on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['dbt/**', 'scripts/**', 'dashboard/**', 'ingestion/**', '.github/workflows/**']

concurrency:
  group: pr-ci-${{ github.event.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  dbt-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: dbt
    env:
      GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}
      DBT_PROFILES_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/dbt
      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_CI }}
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v3
      - run: dbt deps

      - name: PII guard
        run: python ../scripts/check_pii_columns.py models

      - name: Ambil manifest prod terakhir
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --workflow daily_pipeline.yml --branch main --status success --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' || true)
          if [ -n "$RUN_ID" ] && [ "$RUN_ID" != "null" ]; then
            gh run download "$RUN_ID" --name prod-manifest --dir prod_state || true
          fi

      - name: Lint SQL yang berubah (non-blocking dulu)
        run: |
          CHANGED=$(git diff --relative --name-only --diff-filter=AM "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD" -- models | grep '\.sql$' || true)
          if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then
            sqlfluff lint $CHANGED --format github-annotation-native --nofail
          fi

      - name: Slim CI build
        run: |
          if [ -f prod_state/manifest.json ]; then
            dbt build --target ci --select state:modified+ --defer --state prod_state
          else
            dbt build --target ci
          fi

      - name: Hapus dataset CI
        if: always()
        run: |
          for ds in $(bq ls --max_results=1000 --format=json --project_id "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" | jq -r '.[].datasetReference.datasetId' | grep -E "^dbt_ci_pr${PR_NUMBER}(_|$)" || true); do
            bq rm -r -f -d "$GCP_PROJECT_ID:$ds"
          done

name: wif-smoke-test

# Gate Fase 0: membuktikan GitHub Actions bisa autentikasi ke GCP tanpa JSON key,
# dan akses tiap service account sesuai least privilege. Jalankan manual dari tab Actions.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {name: sa-ingest, sa_var: SA_INGEST, can_read: raw_fnb,  cannot_read: marts}
          - {name: sa-dbt,    sa_var: SA_DBT,    can_read: raw_fnb,  cannot_read: ""}
          - {name: sa-export, sa_var: SA_EXPORT, can_read: marts,    cannot_read: raw_fnb}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
      - name: Auth (WIF, tanpa key) sebagai ${{ matrix.name }}
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars[matrix.sa_var] }}
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v3   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
      - name: Akses dataset yang diizinkan harus berhasil
        run: bq ls --project_id="${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}" "${{ matrix.can_read }}"
      - name: Akses dataset terlarang harus ditolak
        if: ${{ matrix.cannot_read != '' }}
        run: |
          if bq ls --project_id="${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}" "${{ matrix.cannot_read }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::${{ matrix.name }} seharusnya TIDAK bisa membaca ${{ matrix.cannot_read }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: akses ke ${{ matrix.cannot_read }} ditolak seperti yang diharapkan"

"""Export mart BigQuery -> JSON statis untuk dashboard Vercel.

Hanya membaca dataset marts dengan allowlist kolom eksplisit per file.
Gagal keras bila ada kolom berpola PII atau file melebihi batas ukuran (2.5 MB).
Memberikan peringatan dini pada 80% kapasitas dan mencatat data_through di meta.json.
"""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import re
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from google.cloud import bigquery

PROJECT = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "fnb-data-platform")
LOCATION = "asia-southeast2"
OUT = Path(__file__).parent / "public" / "data"
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 2_500_000
WARN_FILE_BYTES = int(MAX_FILE_BYTES * 0.8)  # Peringatan di 80% (2 MB)
BANNED_COLUMNS = re.compile(r"phone|email|full_name|birth|_key$|^_dlt_|password|salt", re.I)

# Allowlist eksplisit per export untuk privasi dan optimasi ukuran file
EXPORTS = {
    "pnl_monthly": """
        select
            report_month,

def _json_default(value):
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return int(value) if value % 1 == 0 else float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (dt.date, dt.datetime)):
        return value.isoformat()
    raise TypeError(f"tipe tidak didukung: {type(value)}")


def main() -> None:
    client = bigquery.Client(project=PROJECT, location=LOCATION)
    config = bigquery.QueryJobConfig(
        maximum_bytes_billed=2_000_000_000,
        labels={"app": "dashboard_export"},
    )
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    counts = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    data_through = None

    for name, sql in EXPORTS.items():
        result = client.query(sql.format(p=PROJECT), job_config=config).result()
        banned = [f.name for f in result.schema if BANNED_COLUMNS.search(f.name)]
        if banned:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: kolom terlarang untuk dipublikasikan: {banned}")
        raw_rows = [dict(r.items()) for r in result]
        rows = []
        for r in raw_rows:
            clean_row = {}
            for k, v in r.items():
                if isinstance(v, Decimal):
                    clean_row[k] = int(v) if v % 1 == 0 else float(v)
                elif isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
                    clean_row[k] = int(v)
                else:
                    clean_row[k] = v
            rows.append(clean_row)

        if name == "pnl_daily" and rows:
            dates = [r["report_date"] for r in rows if r.get("report_date")]
            if dates:
                data_through = max(dates)
                if isinstance(data_through, (dt.date, dt.datetime)):
                    data_through = data_through.isoformat()

        payload = json.dumps(rows, default=_json_default, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        file_bytes = len(payload.encode("utf-8"))
        if file_bytes > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: melebihi batas {MAX_FILE_BYTES} byte ({file_bytes} byte); agregasi atau perkecil jendela tanggal")
        if file_bytes >= WARN_FILE_BYTES:
            print(f"::warning::{name} mencapai {file_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB (>= 80% dari batas 2.5 MB)!")

        (OUT / f"{name}.json").write_text(payload, encoding="utf-8")
        counts[name] = len(rows)
        total_bytes += file_bytes
        print(f"Exported {name}: {len(rows)} rows ({file_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB)")

    meta = {
        "generated_at_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "data_through": data_through,
        "rows": counts,
        "total_size_kb": round(total_bytes / 1024, 1),
    }
    (OUT / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, sort_keys=True, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Export marts to JSON selesai dengan sukses! Total data: {total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB (data through {data_through})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

with dates as (
    select date_day from {{ ref('util_dates') }}
),

events as (
    select * from {{ ref('id_calendar_events') }}
),

ramadan_days as (
    select distinct
        d.date_day,
        true as is_ramadan
    from dates as d
    inner join events as e
        on e.event_type = 'Ramadan'
        and d.date_day between e.start_date and e.end_date
),

holiday_days as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        string_agg(e.event_name, ', ' order by e.start_date, e.event_name) as holiday_name,
        string_agg(distinct e.event_type, ', ') as holiday_type,
        true as is_holiday
    from dates as d
    inner join events as e
        on e.event_type != 'Ramadan'
        and d.date_day between e.start_date and e.end_date
    group by 1
)

select
    d.date_day,
    extract(year from d.date_day)                   as year,
    extract(quarter from d.date_day)                as quarter,
    extract(month from d.date_day)                  as month,
    extract(isoyear from d.date_day)                as iso_year,
    extract(isoweek from d.date_day)                as iso_week,
    extract(dayofweek from d.date_day)              as day_of_week_num,
    format_date('%A', d.date_day)                   as day_of_week_name,
    extract(dayofweek from d.date_day) in (1, 7)    as is_weekend,
    extract(day from d.date_day) >= 25
      or extract(day from d.date_day) = 1           as is_payday_window,
    coalesce(h.holiday_name, case when r.is_ramadan then 'Ramadan' end) as calendar_event,
    coalesce(h.holiday_type, case when r.is_ramadan then 'Ramadan' end) as calendar_event_type,
    coalesce(h.is_holiday, false)                   as is_holiday,
    coalesce(r.is_ramadan, false)                   as is_ramadan
from dates as d
left join ramadan_days as r
    on d.date_day = r.date_day
left join holiday_days as h
    on d.date_day = h.date_day

    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d

    group by 1, 2
),

        select a.outlet_id, a.pnl_line, a.amount
        from actual_opex as a
        inner join latest_actual as l on a.period_month = l.max_actual_month
    ) as a
),

all_opex as (
    select * from actual_opex
    union all
    select * from accrued_opex
),

sales_months as (
    select date_trunc(order_date, month) as period_month, outlet_id, sum(net_sales_amount) as net_sales
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2
),

basis as (
    select
        om.period_month,
        om.outlet_id,
        om.active_days_in_month,
        coalesce(sm.net_sales, 0)                                           as net_sales,
        count(*) over (partition by om.period_month)                        as n_outlets,
        sum(coalesce(sm.net_sales, 0)) over (partition by om.period_month)  as total_net_sales
    from outlet_months as om
    left join sales_months as sm
        on sm.period_month = om.period_month and sm.outlet_id = om.outlet_id
),

direct_cost as (
    select
        coalesce(b.period_month, o.period_month) as period_month,
        coalesce(b.outlet_id, 'Unallocated')     as outlet_id,
        o.pnl_line,
        o.amount                                 as allocated_amount,
        coalesce(b.active_days_in_month, extract(day from last_day(o.period_month))) as active_days_in_month,
        if(b.outlet_id is null, 'Unallocated', 'Direct') as allocation_type,
        o.is_opex_estimated
    from all_opex as o
    left join basis as b on b.period_month = o.period_month and b.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    where o.outlet_id is not null
),

shared_cost as (
    select
        coalesce(b.period_month, o.period_month) as period_month,
        coalesce(b.outlet_id, 'Unallocated')     as outlet_id,
        o.pnl_line,
        case
            when b.outlet_id is null then o.amount
            else o.amount * coalesce(
                safe_divide(b.net_sales, b.total_net_sales),
                safe_divide(cast(1 as numeric), cast(b.n_outlets as numeric))
            )
        end as allocated_amount,
        coalesce(b.active_days_in_month, extract(day from last_day(o.period_month))) as active_days_in_month,
        if(b.outlet_id is null, 'Unallocated', 'HQ Allocation') as allocation_type,
        o.is_opex_estimated
    from all_opex as o
    left join basis as b on b.period_month = o.period_month
    where o.outlet_id is null
)

select * from direct_cost
union all
select * from shared_cost
files.dbt/models/core/fct_order_lines.sql:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'order_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'day'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'menu_item_id'],
    tags = ['finance', 'daily']
  )
}}
/*
  Grain   : 1 baris = 1 order_item_id
  Aturan  : is_revenue_line = order Completed AND line Served
            diskon level order dialokasikan pro-rata ke (gross - line_discount)
            diskon yang didanai Platform TIDAK mengurangi net sales merchant
            COGS standar = qty × (std cost menu + std cost modifier) pada tanggal order
*/
with orders as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }}
),

items as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_items') }}
),

item_costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_item_std_cost_daily') }}
),

modifiers as (
    select
        m.order_item_id,
        sum(m.price_delta)                          as modifier_price_per_unit,
        sum(coalesce(c.std_cost_per_unit, 0))       as modifier_cost_per_unit
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_item_modifiers') }} as m
    inner join items as i on i.order_item_id = m.order_item_id
    inner join orders as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    left join item_costs as c
        on c.item_type = 'Modifier'
       and c.item_id = m.modifier_id
       and c.date_day = o.order_date
    group by 1
),

promotions as (
    select promo_code, funded_by from {{ ref('stg_pos__promotions') }}
),

lines as (
    select
        i.order_item_id,
        i.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.ordered_at_local,
        o.outlet_id,
        o.channel_code,
        o.customer_id,
        i.menu_item_id,
        o.order_status,
        i.line_status,
        o.order_status = 'Completed' and i.line_status = 'Served'           as is_revenue_line,
        i.qty,
        i.unit_price,
        coalesce(m.modifier_price_per_unit, 0)                              as modifier_price_per_unit,
        i.qty * (i.unit_price + coalesce(m.modifier_price_per_unit, 0))     as gross_sales_amount,
        i.line_discount_amount,
        o.order_discount_amount,
        coalesce(p.funded_by, 'Merchant')                                   as order_discount_funded_by,
        mc.std_cost_per_unit + coalesce(m.modifier_cost_per_unit, 0)        as std_cost_per_unit
    from items as i
    inner join orders as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    left join modifiers as m on m.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
    left join promotions as p on p.promo_code = o.promo_code
    left join item_costs as mc
        on mc.item_type = 'Menu Item'
       and mc.item_id = i.menu_item_id
       and mc.date_day = o.order_date
),

allocated as (
    select
        *,
        if(
            is_revenue_line,
            coalesce(order_discount_amount * safe_divide(
                gross_sales_amount - line_discount_amount,
                sum(if(is_revenue_line, gross_sales_amount - line_discount_amount, 0)) over (partition by order_id)
            ), 0),
            0
        ) as allocated_order_discount_amount
    from lines
),

final as (
    select
        *,
        if(is_revenue_line,
           line_discount_amount
           + if(order_discount_funded_by = 'Merchant', allocated_order_discount_amount, 0),
           0)                                                               as merchant_discount_amount,
        if(order_discount_funded_by = 'Platform', allocated_order_discount_amount, 0)
                                                                            as platform_funded_discount_amount
    from allocated
)

select
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    ordered_at_local,
    outlet_id,
    channel_code,
    customer_id,
    menu_item_id,
    order_status,
    line_status,
    is_revenue_line,
    qty,
    unit_price,
    modifier_price_per_unit,
    gross_sales_amount,
    line_discount_amount,
    allocated_order_discount_amount,
    order_discount_funded_by,
    merchant_discount_amount,
    platform_funded_discount_amount,
    if(is_revenue_line, gross_sales_amount - merchant_discount_amount, 0)  as net_sales_amount,
    std_cost_per_unit,
    if(is_revenue_line, qty * std_cost_per_unit, 0)                        as cogs_std_amount
from final
files.dbt/models/core/fct_orders.sql:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'order_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'channel_code'],
    tags = ['finance', 'daily']
  )
}}

with orders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }}
),

lines as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(gross_sales_amount)         as gross_sales_amount,
        sum(merchant_discount_amount)   as merchant_discount_amount,
        sum(net_sales_amount)           as net_sales_amount,
        sum(cogs_std_amount)            as cogs_std_amount,
        sum(qty)                        as units
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1
),

payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount)                                                 as paid_amount,
        sum(mdr_fee_amount)                                         as payment_fee_amount,
        string_agg(distinct payment_method order by payment_method) as payment_methods
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__payments') }}
    group by 1
),

rates as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__channel_commission_rates') }}
)

select
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.ordered_at_local,
    o.order_hour_local,
    o.outlet_id,
    o.channel_code,
    o.customer_id,
    o.promo_code,
    o.order_status,
    o.guest_count,
    coalesce(l.gross_sales_amount, 0)                               as gross_sales_amount,
    coalesce(l.merchant_discount_amount, 0)                         as merchant_discount_amount,
    coalesce(l.net_sales_amount, 0)                                 as net_sales_amount,
    coalesce(l.cogs_std_amount, 0)                                  as cogs_std_amount,
    coalesce(l.units, 0)                                            as units,
    o.service_charge_amount,
    o.tax_amount,
    o.total_amount,
    coalesce(p.paid_amount, 0)                                      as paid_amount,
    coalesce(p.payment_fee_amount, 0)                               as payment_fee_amount,
    p.payment_methods,
    coalesce(r.commission_pct, 0)                                   as commission_pct,
    if(o.order_status = 'Completed',
       coalesce(l.net_sales_amount, 0) * coalesce(r.commission_pct, 0) / 100,
       0)                                                           as channel_commission_amount
from orders as o
left join lines as l on l.order_id = o.order_id
left join payments as p on p.order_id = o.order_id
left join rates as r
    on r.channel_code = o.channel_code
   and o.order_date >= r.effective_from
   and o.order_date <  coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
files.dbt/models/core/fct_refunds.sql:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'refund_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id'],
    tags = ['finance', 'daily']
  )
}}

with refunds as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__refunds') }}
),

orders as (
    select
        order_id,
        outlet_id,
        channel_code,
        total_amount,
        tax_amount,
        service_charge_amount,
        net_sales_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

lines as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        net_sales_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
)

select
    r.refund_id,
    r.order_id,
    o.outlet_id,
    o.channel_code,
    r.order_item_id,
    r.refund_date,
    r.refunded_at_local,
    r.refund_amount                                     as refund_gross_amount,
    case
        when r.order_item_id is not null and l.net_sales_amount is not null then
            least(l.net_sales_amount, r.refund_amount)
        else
            r.refund_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(o.net_sales_amount, o.total_amount), 1)
    end                                                 as refund_net_amount,
    r.refund_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(o.tax_amount, o.total_amount), 0)
                                                        as refund_tax_amount,
    r.refund_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(o.service_charge_amount, o.total_amount), 0)
                                                        as refund_service_charge_amount,
    r.refund_amount,
    r.refund_reason,
    r.approved_by_employee_id
from refunds as r
left join orders as o on o.order_id = r.order_id
left join lines as l on l.order_item_id = r.order_item_id

{{

with waste as (

ingredients as (

files.dbt/models/intermediate/costing/int_item:
/*
  Grain   : date_day x item_type x item_id x ingredient_id (bahan raw)
  item_type: 'Menu Item' | 'Modifier' | 'Prep Item' | 'Ingredient'
  Rumus   : qty bruto per unit = qty_per_yield / (1 - loss_pct/100) / yield_qty
  Asumsi  : prep item hanya tersusun dari bahan raw (dijaga test assert_prep_recipes_only_raw)
*/
with dates as (
    select date_day
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }}
    where date_day between {{ var('start_date') }} and current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}')
),

ingredients as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }}
),

recipes as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }}
),

recipe_lines as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipe_lines') }}
),

modifier_lines as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__modifier_lines') }}
),

recipe_lines_on_day as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        if(r.menu_item_id is not null, 'Menu Item', 'Prep Item')      as item_type,
        coalesce(r.menu_item_id, r.prep_ingredient_id)                 as item_id,
        rl.ingredient_id                                               as component_id,
        rl.qty_per_yield / (1 - rl.loss_pct / 100) / r.yield_qty       as qty_per_unit
    from dates as d
    inner join recipes as r
        on d.date_day >= r.effective_from
       and d.date_day <  coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
    inner join recipe_lines as rl
        on rl.recipe_id = r.recipe_id
),

modifier_lines_on_day as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        'Modifier'          as item_type,
        ml.modifier_id      as item_id,
        ml.ingredient_id    as component_id,
        ml.qty_delta        as qty_per_unit
    from dates as d
    cross join modifier_lines as ml
),

first_level as (
    select * from recipe_lines_on_day
    union all
    select * from modifier_lines_on_day
),

prep_to_raw as (
    select date_day, item_id as prep_id, component_id as raw_id, qty_per_unit
    from recipe_lines_on_day
    where item_type = 'Prep Item'
),

exploded as (
    -- 1) komponen raw langsung
    select f.date_day, f.item_type, f.item_id, f.component_id as ingredient_id, f.qty_per_unit
    from first_level as f
    inner join ingredients as i
        on i.ingredient_id = f.component_id
       and not i.is_prep_item

    union all

    -- 2) komponen prep diurai ke bahan raw (left join agar prep tanpa resep aktif tetap keluar dengan raw_id NULL)
    select
        f.date_day,
        f.item_type,
        f.item_id,
        p.raw_id as ingredient_id,
        f.qty_per_unit * coalesce(p.qty_per_unit, cast(1 as numeric)) as qty_per_unit
    from first_level as f
    inner join ingredients as i
        on i.ingredient_id = f.component_id
       and i.is_prep_item
    left join prep_to_raw as p
        on p.date_day = f.date_day
       and p.prep_id = f.component_id

    union all

    -- 3) bahan raw sebagai dirinya sendiri (untuk valuasi waste & stock)
    select d.date_day, 'Ingredient', i.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_id, cast(1 as numeric)
    from dates as d
    cross join ingredients as i
    where not i.is_prep_item
)

select
    date_day,
    item_type,
    item_id,
    ingredient_id,
    sum(qty_per_unit) as qty_per_unit
from exploded
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

/*
  Grain  : date_day x item_type x item_id
  Isi    : standard cost per 1 unit item = Σ qty bahan raw × standard cost bahan yang berlaku hari itu
  Kontrol: n_components_missing_cost wajib 0 (test) → mencegah HPP diam-diam terlalu rendah
*/
with explosion as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_item_explosion_daily') }}
),

costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredient_standard_costs') }}
)

select
    e.date_day,
    e.item_type,
    e.item_id,
    sum(e.qty_per_unit * c.standard_cost_per_base_uom)  as std_cost_per_unit,
    count(*)                                            as n_components,
    countif(c.ingredient_id is null)                    as n_components_missing_cost
from explosion as e
left join costs as c
    on c.ingredient_id = e.ingredient_id
   and e.date_day >= c.effective_from
   and e.date_day <  coalesce(c.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
group by 1, 2, 3

files.dbt/models/marts/mart_category_performan:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'report_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'category_name'],
    tags = ['sales', 'finance', 'daily', 'mart']
) }}

with lines as (
    select
        f.order_date                                as report_date,
        f.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized')  as category_name,
        count(*)                                    as line_count,
        sum(f.qty)                                  as units_sold,
        sum(f.gross_sales_amount)                   as gross_sales,
        sum(f.merchant_discount_amount)            as discounts,
        sum(f.cogs_std_amount)                     as cogs_standard
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as f
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on f.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where f.is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

refund_lines as (
    -- Item-level refund
    select
        r.refund_date as report_date,
        r.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized') as category_name,
        r.refund_net_amount as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on l.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is not null

    union all

    -- Order-level refund dialokasikan ke masing-masing item sesuai proporsi net_sales
    select
        r.refund_date as report_date,
        r.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized') as category_name,
        r.refund_net_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(l.net_sales_amount, o.net_sales_amount), 0) as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
        on o.order_id = r.order_id
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_id = r.order_id and l.is_revenue_line
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on l.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is null
),

category_refunds as (
    select
        report_date,
        outlet_id,
        category_name,
        sum(refund_amount) as refunds
    from refund_lines
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

keys as (
    select report_date, outlet_id, category_name from lines
    union distinct
    select report_date, outlet_id, category_name from category_refunds
)

select
    k.report_date,
    k.outlet_id,
    k.category_name,

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['inventory', 'mart']
) }}

with raw_counts as (
    -- bahan raw langsung
    select
        c.outlet_id,
        c.ingredient_id,
        c.count_date,
        c.counted_qty_base
    from {{ ref('fct_stock_counts') }} as c
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i
        on i.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id
       and not i.is_prep_item

    union all

    -- prep item diurai ke ekuivalen bahan raw
    select
        c.outlet_id,
        x.ingredient_id,
        c.count_date,
        c.counted_qty_base * x.qty_per_unit as counted_qty_base
    from {{ ref('fct_stock_counts') }} as c
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i
        on i.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id
       and i.is_prep_item
    inner join {{ ref('int_item_explosion_daily') }} as x
        on x.date_day = c.count_date
       and x.item_type = 'Prep Item'
       and x.item_id = c.ingredient_id
),

counts as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        count_date,
        sum(counted_qty_base) as counted_qty_base
    from raw_counts
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

periods as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        lag(count_date) over w          as period_start,
        count_date                      as period_end,
        lag(counted_qty_base) over w    as opening_qty,
        counted_qty_base                as closing_qty
    from counts
    window w as (partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id order by count_date)
),

period_movements as (
    select
        p.outlet_id,
        p.ingredient_id,
        p.period_end,
        sum(coalesce(m.purchased_qty, 0))           as purchased_qty,
        sum(coalesce(m.purchased_amount, 0))        as purchased_amount,
        sum(coalesce(m.theoretical_sales_qty, 0))   as theoretical_sales_qty,
        sum(coalesce(m.waste_qty, 0))               as recorded_waste_qty
    from periods as p
    left join {{ ref('fct_inventory_movements_daily') }} as m
        on m.outlet_id = p.outlet_id
       and m.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and m.movement_date > p.period_start
       and m.movement_date <= p.period_end
    where p.period_start is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

costs as (
    select date_day, item_id as ingredient_id, std_cost_per_unit
    from {{ ref('int_item_std_cost_daily') }}
    where item_type = 'Ingredient'
),

calc as (
    select
        p.outlet_id,
        p.ingredient_id,
        p.period_start,
        p.period_end,
        p.opening_qty,
        pm.purchased_qty,
        pm.purchased_amount,
        p.closing_qty,
        p.opening_qty + pm.purchased_qty - p.closing_qty                    as actual_usage_qty,
        pm.theoretical_sales_qty,
        pm.recorded_waste_qty,
        p.opening_qty + pm.purchased_qty - p.closing_qty
            - pm.theoretical_sales_qty - pm.recorded_waste_qty              as unexplained_variance_qty,
        c.std_cost_per_unit
    from periods as p
    inner join period_movements as pm
        on pm.outlet_id = p.outlet_id
       and pm.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and pm.period_end = p.period_end
    left join costs as c
        on c.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and c.date_day = p.period_end
)

select
    {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['outlet_id', 'ingredient_id', 'period_end']) }} as inventory_period_key,
    *,
    unexplained_variance_qty * std_cost_per_unit                                         as unexplained_variance_value,
    theoretical_sales_qty * std_cost_per_unit                                            as theoretical_usage_value,
    {{ safe_pct('unexplained_variance_qty', 'theoretical_sales_qty') }}                  as unexplained_variance_pct
from calc

with base as (

        cast(channel_cost_pct as numeric) as channel_cost_pct
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_monthly') }}
),

kpi as (
    select report_month, outlet_id, is_complete_month, metric_code, metric_value
    from base
    unpivot (metric_value for metric_code in (
        food_cost_pct, waste_pct, prime_cost_pct, gross_margin_pct, inventory_variance_pct, channel_cost_pct
    ))
),

outlets as (
    select outlet_id, outlet_type from {{ ref('dim_outlet') }}
),

thresholds as (
    select * from {{ ref('kpi_thresholds') }}
)

select
    k.report_month,
    k.outlet_id,
    k.is_complete_month,
    k.metric_code,
    t.metric_name,
    t.direction,
    k.metric_value,
    t.warn_threshold,
    t.critical_threshold,
    case
        when k.metric_code = 'inventory_variance_pct' and abs(k.metric_value) >= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when k.metric_code = 'inventory_variance_pct' and abs(k.metric_value) >= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        when t.direction = 'higher_is_worse' and k.metric_value >= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when t.direction = 'higher_is_worse' and k.metric_value >= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        when t.direction = 'lower_is_worse'  and k.metric_value <= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when t.direction = 'lower_is_worse'  and k.metric_value <= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        else 'OK'
    end as status
from kpi as k
left join outlets as o on o.outlet_id = k.outlet_id
inner join thresholds as t
    on t.metric_code = k.metric_code
   and coalesce(t.outlet_type, 'ALL') in (o.outlet_type, 'ALL')
   and k.report_month >= t.effective_from
   and k.report_month <  coalesce(t.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by k.report_month, k.outlet_id, k.metric_code
    order by if(t.outlet_type = o.outlet_type, 1, 2)
) = 1

with lines as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        date_trunc(order_date, month)   as report_month,

        sum(net_sales_amount)           as gross_net_sales,

    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

refund_lines as (
    -- Item-level refund
    select
        date_trunc(r.refund_date, month) as report_month,
        r.outlet_id,
        l.menu_item_id,
        r.refund_net_amount as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is not null

    union all

    -- Order-level refund dialokasikan ke masing-masing item sesuai proporsi net_sales
    select
        date_trunc(r.refund_date, month) as report_month,
        r.outlet_id,
        l.menu_item_id,
        r.refund_net_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(l.net_sales_amount, o.net_sales_amount), 0) as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
        on o.order_id = r.order_id
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_id = r.order_id and l.is_revenue_line
    where r.order_item_id is null
),

item_refunds as (
    select
        report_month,
        outlet_id,
        menu_item_id,
        sum(refund_amount) as refunds
    from refund_lines
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

items as (
    select
        l.outlet_id,
        l.report_month,
        l.menu_item_id,
        l.qty_sold,
        l.gross_net_sales - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) as net_sales,
        l.cogs_standard
    from lines as l
    left join item_refunds as r
        on r.report_month = l.report_month
       and r.outlet_id = l.outlet_id
       and r.menu_item_id = l.menu_item_id
),

calc as (
    select
        *,
        safe_divide(net_sales - cogs_standard, qty_sold)                                    as avg_contribution_margin,
        safe_divide(qty_sold, sum(qty_sold) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month))    as menu_mix_pct,
        count(*) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month)                                as n_items_sold,
        safe_divide(
            sum(net_sales - cogs_standard) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month),
            sum(qty_sold) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month)
        )                                                                                   as weighted_avg_cm
    from items
),

flags as (
    select
        *,
        menu_mix_pct >= 0.7 / n_items_sold          as is_high_popularity,
        avg_contribution_margin >= weighted_avg_cm  as is_high_profitability
    from calc
)

select

    case
        when is_high_popularity and is_high_profitability then 'Star'
        when is_high_popularity then 'Plowhorse'
        when is_high_profitability then 'Puzzle'

    end                                                         as menu_class,
    d.menu_name,
    d.category_name

files.dbt/models/marts/mart_pnl_daily.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'report_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id'],
    tags = ['finance', 'mart']
) }}

with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') - 1) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

outlet_days as (
    select d.date_day as report_date, o.outlet_id
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    cross join max_data_date as m
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__outlets') }} as o
        on d.date_day between o.opened_date
                          and coalesce(o.closed_date, m.max_date)
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
      and d.date_day <= m.max_date

    union all

    select d.date_day as report_date, 'Unallocated' as outlet_id
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    cross join max_data_date as m
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
      and d.date_day <= m.max_date
      and exists (
          select 1 from {{ ref('fct_opex_allocated_monthly') }}
          where outlet_id = 'Unallocated'
            and period_month = date_trunc(d.date_day, month)
      )
),

sales as (
    select
        order_date                      as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        sum(gross_sales_amount)         as gross_sales,
        sum(merchant_discount_amount)   as discounts,
        sum(cogs_std_amount)            as cogs_standard,
        sum(qty)                        as units_sold
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2
),

orders as (
    select
        order_date                          as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        count(*)                            as order_count,
        sum(channel_commission_amount)      as channel_commission,
        sum(payment_fee_amount)             as payment_fees
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
    where order_status = 'Completed'
    group by 1, 2
),

refunds as (
    select
        refund_date as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        sum(refund_net_amount) as refunds,
        sum(refund_tax_amount) as tax_refunds
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

waste as (
    select waste_date as report_date, outlet_id, sum(waste_cost_amount) as waste_cost
    from {{ ref('fct_waste') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

opex_daily as (
    select
        period_month,
        outlet_id,
        sum(if(pnl_line = 'Labor', allocated_amount, 0)) / nullif(any_value(active_days_in_month), 0)   as labor_cost,
        sum(if(pnl_line != 'Labor', allocated_amount, 0)) / nullif(any_value(active_days_in_month), 0)  as other_opex,
        logical_or(is_opex_estimated)                                                                     as is_opex_estimated
    from {{ ref('fct_opex_allocated_monthly') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

joined as (
    select
        od.report_date,
        date_trunc(od.report_date, month)                                   as report_month,
        od.outlet_id,
        coalesce(o.order_count, 0)                                          as order_count,
        coalesce(s.units_sold, 0)                                           as units_sold,
        coalesce(s.gross_sales, 0)                                          as gross_sales,
        coalesce(s.discounts, 0)                                            as discounts,
        coalesce(r.refunds, 0)                                              as refunds,
        coalesce(s.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(s.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) as net_sales,
        coalesce(s.cogs_standard, 0)                                        as cogs_standard,
        coalesce(w.waste_cost, 0)                                           as waste_cost,
        coalesce(o.channel_commission, 0)                                   as channel_commission,
        coalesce(o.payment_fees, 0)                                         as payment_fees,
        coalesce(x.labor_cost, 0)                                           as labor_cost,
        coalesce(x.other_opex, 0)                                           as other_opex,
        coalesce(x.is_opex_estimated, false)                                as is_opex_estimated
    from outlet_days as od
    left join sales as s on s.report_date = od.report_date and s.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join orders as o on o.report_date = od.report_date and o.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join refunds as r on r.report_date = od.report_date and r.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join waste as w on w.report_date = od.report_date and w.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join opex_daily as x
        on x.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
       and x.period_month = date_trunc(od.report_date, month)
),

calc as (
    select
        *,
        cogs_standard + waste_cost                                              as cost_of_sales,
        net_sales - cogs_standard - waste_cost                                  as gross_profit,
        net_sales - cogs_standard - waste_cost - channel_commission - payment_fees
                                                                                as contribution_after_channel,
        net_sales - cogs_standard - waste_cost - channel_commission - payment_fees
            - labor_cost - other_opex                                           as outlet_ebitda
    from joined
)

select
    *,
    {{ safe_pct('cost_of_sales', 'net_sales') }}                as food_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('waste_cost', 'net_sales') }}                   as waste_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('cost_of_sales + labor_cost', 'net_sales') }}   as prime_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('gross_profit', 'net_sales') }}                 as gross_margin_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('outlet_ebitda', 'net_sales') }}                as ebitda_margin_pct,
    safe_divide(net_sales, nullif(order_count, 0))              as avg_order_value
from calc
files.dbt/models/marts/mart_pnl_monthly.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['finance', 'mart']
) }}

with daily as (
    select * from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }}
),

variance as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        date_trunc(period_end, month)       as report_month,
        sum(unexplained_variance_value)     as inventory_variance_cost
    from {{ ref('mart_inventory_variance') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

monthly as (
    select
        report_month,
        outlet_id,
        count(*)                        as reported_days,
        sum(order_count)                as order_count,
        sum(gross_sales)                as gross_sales,
        sum(discounts)                  as discounts,
        sum(refunds)                    as refunds,
        sum(net_sales)                  as net_sales,
        sum(cogs_standard)              as cogs_standard,
        sum(waste_cost)                 as waste_cost,
        sum(channel_commission)         as channel_commission,
        sum(payment_fees)               as payment_fees,
        sum(labor_cost)                 as labor_cost,
        sum(other_opex)                 as other_opex,
        logical_or(is_opex_estimated)   as is_opex_estimated
    from daily
    group by 1, 2
),

calc as (
    select
        m.*,
        m.report_month < date_trunc(current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}'), month)    as is_complete_month,
        coalesce(v.inventory_variance_cost, 0)                                      as inventory_variance_cost,
        m.cogs_standard + m.waste_cost                                              as theoretical_cost_of_sales,
        m.cogs_standard + m.waste_cost + coalesce(v.inventory_variance_cost, 0)     as actual_cost_of_sales
    from monthly as m
    left join variance as v on v.outlet_id = m.outlet_id and v.report_month = m.report_month
),

pnl as (
    select
        *,
        net_sales - actual_cost_of_sales                                            as gross_profit,
        net_sales - actual_cost_of_sales - channel_commission - payment_fees
            - labor_cost - other_opex                                               as outlet_ebitda
    from calc
)

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'waste_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'reason_code'],
    tags = ['inventory', 'mart']
) }}

with waste as (
    select
        w.outlet_id,
        w.waste_date,
        w.reason_code,
        w.reason_name,
        w.controllability,
        case
            when w.item_type = 'Menu Item' then coalesce(m.category_name, 'Finished Menu')
            when w.item_type = 'Prep Item' then 'Prep Batch'
            else coalesce(i.ingredient_category, 'Raw Ingredient')
        end as item_category,
        sum(w.qty)                  as waste_qty,
        sum(w.waste_cost_amount)    as waste_cost
    from {{ ref('fct_waste') }} as w
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m on m.menu_item_id = w.item_id and w.item_type = 'Menu Item'
    left join {{ ref('dim_ingredient') }} as i on i.ingredient_id = w.item_id and w.item_type in ('Ingredient', 'Prep Item')
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
),

pnl as (
    select
        report_date,
        outlet_id,
        net_sales
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }}
)

select
    w.outlet_id,
    w.waste_date,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_name,
    w.controllability,
    w.item_category,
    w.waste_qty,
    w.waste_cost,
    p.net_sales as outlet_daily_net_sales,
    {{ safe_pct('w.waste_cost', 'p.net_sales') }} as waste_pct_of_sales
from waste as w
left join pnl as p on p.report_date = w.waste_date and p.outlet_id = w.outlet_id

files.dbt/tests/assert_active_prep_components_:
-- Memastikan setiap komponen prep item dalam resep menu/modifier aktif memiliki resep prep aktif pada setiap tanggal aktifnya
with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}')) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

active_prep_components as (
    select
        r.effective_from,
        coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31') as effective_to,
        rl.ingredient_id as prep_id
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__recipe_lines') }} as rl on rl.recipe_id = r.recipe_id
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i on i.ingredient_id = rl.ingredient_id
    where i.is_prep_item
),

prep_recipes as (
    select
        prep_ingredient_id as prep_id,
        effective_from,
        coalesce(effective_to, date '9999-12-31') as effective_to
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }}
    where prep_ingredient_id is not null
),

component_days as (
    select distinct
        c.prep_id,
        d.date_day
    from active_prep_components as c
    cross join max_data_date as m
    inner join {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
        on d.date_day between c.effective_from and least(c.effective_to, m.max_date)
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
)

select
    cd.prep_id,
    cd.date_day
from component_days as cd
left join prep_recipes as p
    on p.prep_id = cd.prep_id
   and cd.date_day >= p.effective_from
   and cd.date_day < p.effective_to
where p.prep_id is null

-- tests/assert_opex_reconciles.sql : opex di mart_pnl_daily = opex sumber, untuk bulan lengkap
with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') - 1) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),
mart as (
    select m.report_month, sum(m.labor_cost + m.other_opex) as opex
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }} as m
    cross join max_data_date as x
    where m.report_month < date_trunc(x.max_date, month)
      and not coalesce(m.is_opex_estimated, false)
    group by 1
),
src as (
    select period_month as report_month, sum(amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__operating_expenses') }}
    group by 1
)
select
    m.report_month,
    m.opex as mart_opex,
    s.opex as source_opex
from mart as m
inner join src as s on s.report_month = m.report_month
where abs(coalesce(m.opex, 0) - coalesce(s.opex, 0)) > 1
-- tests/assert_order_totals_reconcile.sql
-- Memastikan total amount order sama dengan:
-- net_sales_amount - platform_funded_discount_amount + service_charge_amount + tax_amount
-- Catatan: net_sales_amount sengaja tidak mengurangi diskon yang didanai platform (merchant tetap diakui pendapatannya),
-- namun total_amount yang dibayar pelanggan mengurangi seluruh diskon (merchant + platform).
with line_totals as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(net_sales_amount) as total_net_lines,
        sum(platform_funded_discount_amount) as total_platform_discounts
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1
),

orders as (
    select
        o.order_id,
        o.total_amount,
        o.service_charge_amount,
        o.tax_amount,
        coalesce(l.total_net_lines, 0) as total_net_lines,
        coalesce(l.total_platform_discounts, 0) as total_platform_discounts,
        coalesce(l.total_net_lines, 0) - coalesce(l.total_platform_discounts, 0)
            + o.service_charge_amount + o.tax_amount as calculated_total
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
    left join line_totals as l on l.order_id = o.order_id
    where o.order_status = 'Completed'
)

select
    order_id,
    total_amount,
    calculated_total,
    abs(total_amount - calculated_total) as diff
from orders
where abs(total_amount - calculated_total) > 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bootstrap GCP untuk F&B Data Platform (plan v2.1, §6).
# Idempotent: aman dijalankan ulang. Tidak membuat JSON key (semua keyless via WIF).
#
# Prasyarat (manual, sekali):
#   1. Project GCP sudah dibuat dan billing sudah di-link   (plan §6.1)
#   2. gcloud auth login && gcloud auth application-default login
#   3. export GCP_PROJECT_ID=... GITHUB_REPO=owner/repo     (lihat .env.example)
#
# Opsional: GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID (untuk membuat budget alert), GCP_REGION.
set -euo pipefail

: "${GCP_PROJECT_ID:?set GCP_PROJECT_ID}"
: "${GITHUB_REPO:?set GITHUB_REPO (format owner/repo)}"
REGION="${GCP_REGION:-asia-southeast2}"
PROJECT="$GCP_PROJECT_ID"
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

log() { printf '\n==> %s\n' "$*"; }

log "Project: $PROJECT | region: $REGION | repo: $GITHUB_REPO"
gcloud config set project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null
PROJECT_NUMBER="$(gcloud projects describe "$PROJECT" --format='value(projectNumber)')"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- API
log "Aktifkan API"
gcloud services enable \
  bigquery.googleapis.com \
  iamcredentials.googleapis.com \
  sts.googleapis.com \
  cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com \
  billingbudgets.googleapis.com \
  --project "$PROJECT"

# ------------------------------------------------------------ Service account
SERVICE_ACCOUNTS=(sa-ingest sa-dbt sa-github-ci sa-export)
log "Service account"
for sa in "${SERVICE_ACCOUNTS[@]}"; do
  if ! gcloud iam service-accounts describe "$sa@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gcloud iam service-accounts create "$sa" --display-name "$sa (fnb data platform)" --project "$PROJECT"
  fi
done

# Role level project (minimal). Akses data diberikan per dataset di bigquery_setup.sql.
grant_project_role() {
  gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding "$PROJECT" \
    --member "serviceAccount:$1@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
    --role "$2" --condition=None --quiet >/dev/null
}
log "Role project"
grant_project_role sa-ingest roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-dbt    roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-export roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-github-ci roles/bigquery.user        # boleh membuat dataset CI per PR

# ------------------------------------------------------ Workload Identity Federation
log "Workload Identity Federation (GitHub Actions, tanpa key)"
if ! gcloud iam workload-identity-pools describe github --location=global --project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create github --location=global --project "$PROJECT" \
    --display-name "GitHub Actions"
fi
if ! gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers describe github-oidc \
     --location=global --workload-identity-pool=github --project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers create-oidc github-oidc \
    --location=global --workload-identity-pool=github --project "$PROJECT" \
    --issuer-uri="https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" \
    --attribute-mapping="google.subject=assertion.sub,attribute.repository=assertion.repository,attribute.repository_id=assertion.repository_id,attribute.ref=assertion.ref" \
    --attribute-condition="assertion.repository=='${GITHUB_REPO}'"
fi

# sa-github-ci dapat diimpersonasi oleh repo ini (seluruh branch / PR)
PRINCIPAL_REPO="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_NUMBER}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/attribute.repository/${GITHUB_REPO}"
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding "sa-github-ci@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role=roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser --member="$PRINCIPAL_REPO" --project "$PROJECT" --quiet >/dev/null

# SA prod (sa-ingest, sa-dbt, sa-export) hanya dapat diimpersonasi oleh branch main
PRINCIPAL_MAIN="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_NUMBER}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/attribute.ref/refs/heads/main"
for sa in sa-ingest sa-dbt sa-export; do
  gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding "$sa@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
    --role=roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser --member="$PRINCIPAL_MAIN" --project "$PROJECT" --quiet >/dev/null
done

WIF_PROVIDER="projects/${PROJECT_NUMBER}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/providers/github-oidc"

# ------------------------------------------------------------ Dataset + grant + salt
log "Dataset, grant dataset, dan salt PII (bigquery_setup.sql)"
sed "s/<PROJECT_ID>/${PROJECT}/g; s/<REGION>/${REGION}/g" "$HERE/bigquery_setup.sql" \
  | bq query --project_id="$PROJECT" --location="$REGION" --use_legacy_sql=false --quiet

# ------------------------------------------------------------ Budget alert (opsional)
if [[ -n "${GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID:-}" ]]; then
  BUDGET_AMOUNT="${GCP_BUDGET_AMOUNT:-1USD}"
  log "Budget alert ${BUDGET_AMOUNT} (notifikasi saja, tidak menghentikan tagihan)"
  if gcloud billing budgets list --billing-account="$GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID" \
       --format='value(displayName)' | grep -qx 'fnb-guard'; then
    echo "Budget fnb-guard sudah ada, dilewati."
  else
    gcloud billing budgets create --billing-account="$GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID" \
      --display-name="fnb-guard" --budget-amount="${BUDGET_AMOUNT}" \
      --filter-projects="projects/${PROJECT_NUMBER}" \
      --threshold-rule=percent=0.5 --threshold-rule=percent=0.9 --threshold-rule=percent=1.0
  fi
else
  echo "GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID kosong: buat budget alert manual (plan §6.4)."
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------ Ringkasan
cat <<EOF

================================================================
SELESAI. Langkah manual yang tersisa (tidak bisa lewat CLI):

  1. Custom quota (WAJIB sebelum job pertama):
     Console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas & System Limits
     -> BigQuery API -> "Query usage per day" -> set 20 GB (20480 MiB)
     (20 GB x 31 = 620 GB < 1 TB gratis)

  2. Simpan di GitHub (Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions):
     Variables:
       GCP_PROJECT_ID = ${PROJECT}
       WIF_PROVIDER   = ${WIF_PROVIDER}
       SA_INGEST      = sa-ingest@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
       SA_DBT         = sa-dbt@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
       SA_CI          = sa-github-ci@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
       SA_EXPORT      = sa-export@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
     Secrets:
       SOURCE_DATABASE_URL = (connection string Neon fnb-oltp)

  3. Verifikasi: jalankan workflow "wif-smoke-test" dari tab Actions,
     lalu: bq ls --project_id=${PROJECT}
================================================================
EOF
files.ingestion/pipeline.py:
"""Ingest OLTP Neon (schema fnb) -> BigQuery dataset raw_fnb via dlt.

Semua 29 tabel: incremental berdasarkan updated_at, merge by primary key (direfleksi dari Postgres).
Memakai BigQuery load jobs (gratis, bukan streaming insert).
"""
import os
import sys
import dlt
from dlt.sources.sql_database import sql_database

TABLES = [
    "outlets", "employees", "customers", "sales_channels", "channel_commission_rates", "promotions",
    "menu_categories", "menu_items", "menu_item_prices", "modifiers", "modifier_lines",
    "ingredients", "ingredient_standard_costs", "suppliers", "recipes", "recipe_lines",
    "orders", "order_items", "order_item_modifiers", "payments", "refunds",
    "goods_receipts", "goods_receipt_lines", "stock_counts", "stock_count_lines",
    "waste_reasons", "waste_logs", "expense_categories", "operating_expenses",
]


def get_db_credentials() -> str:
    url = os.environ.get("SOURCE_DATABASE_URL")
    if not url:
        sys.exit("SOURCE_DATABASE_URL belum diset.")
    if url.startswith("postgresql://"):
        return url.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+psycopg2://", 1)
    return url


def main() -> None:
    db_uri = get_db_credentials()
    project_id = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "fnb-data-platform")
    location = os.environ.get("GCP_REGION", "asia-southeast2")

    print(f"Menjalankan dlt pipeline Postgres -> BigQuery [{project_id}:{location} / raw_fnb]...")

    source = sql_database(
        credentials=db_uri,
        schema="fnb",
        table_names=TABLES,
        backend="pyarrow",
        reflection_level="full_with_precision",
    )

    for name in TABLES:
        # Incremental berdasarkan updated_at, merge by PK dari Postgres
        # lag=3600.0 (1 jam) memastikan commit lambat tetap terbaca
        source.resources[name].apply_hints(
            incremental=dlt.sources.incremental("updated_at", lag=3600.0),
            write_disposition="merge",
        )

    destination = dlt.destinations.bigquery(location=location)

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipeline_name="fnb_pos_to_bigquery",
        destination=destination,
        dataset_name="raw_fnb",
    )

    load_info = pipeline.run(source)
    print(load_info)
    load_info.raise_on_failed_jobs()
    print("Ingestion selesai dengan sukses!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
